about_zh: 把东西跑起来、跑稳：容器、部署、CI、监控。

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for.dev 是一个面向开发者和运维人员的精选免费服务清单，涵盖 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 等基础设施类工具。该列表聚焦于 DevOps 和系统管理员常用服务，强调长期可用的免费层级（非试用），并排除自托管软件。内容由社区协作维护，包含云管理、CI/CD、监控、安全等 30+ 个分类，帮助开发者快速发现并评估适合的免费资源。
repos.summary_en: free-for.dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services tailored for developers and infrastructure teams. It focuses on tools useful for DevOps, sysadmins, and cloud engineers, excluding self-hosted software and limited-time trials. Maintained by a community of 1600+ contributors, it covers 30+ categories including cloud management, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and more, enabling informed decisions about free developer offerings.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: 🌐 The Internet Computer! Free, Open-Source, and Self-Hostable.
repos.summary_zh: Puter 是一个开源的个人互联网操作系统，提供文件管理、应用商店和远程桌面功能，支持自托管与云端部署。它具备隐私优先的云存储能力，可作为 Dropbox 或 Google Drive 的替代方案，同时支持网站、Web 应用和游戏的开发与发布，适用于个人云、服务器管理和学习分布式系统。
repos.summary_en: Puter is an open-source personal internet OS offering file management, app store, and remote desktop capabilities. It supports self-hosting and cloud deployment, functioning as a privacy-focused alternative to services like Dropbox or Google Drive, while enabling web app development and distributed system learning.

repos.description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
repos.summary_zh: Sentry 是一款开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，提供实时问题检测、错误追踪、性能分析和用户行为回放功能，支持 20+ 编程语言和框架的官方 SDK，助力团队快速定位并修复代码缺陷。
repos.summary_en: Sentry is a developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that enables real-time issue detection, error tracing, performance insights, and user session replay. It supports 20+ languages via official SDKs, helping teams debug and resolve problems faster.

repos.description: 🌩 Self-hosted file management and sharing system, supports multiple storage providers
repos.summary_zh: Cloudreve 是一个自托管文件管理与共享系统，支持对接本地、OneDrive、S3、七牛云、阿里云OSS等十余种存储后端。提供 WebDAV、在线预览、拖拽上传、批量下载、多用户权限管理等功能，开箱即用，适合企业或个人私有云部署。
repos.summary_en: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system supporting multiple storage backends like Local, OneDrive, S3, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, etc. It offers features such as WebDAV, online preview, drag-and-drop upload, batch download, multi-user/group access control, and is ready-to-use for private cloud deployment.

repos.description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
repos.summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
repos.summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: DDNS-GO 是一款轻量级动态域名解析服务工具，支持多平台（Mac/Windows/Linux）及主流云服务商（阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等），自动获取公网 IPv4/IPv6 地址并更新对应域名记录。具备网页配置界面、日志查看、Webhook 通知、多级域名解析和自定义参数传递功能，支持 Docker 部署与系统服务化运行。
repos.summary_en: DDNS-GO is a lightweight dynamic DNS tool supporting multiple platforms (Mac/Windows/Linux) and cloud providers (Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, etc.). It automatically fetches public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates domain records via a web-based interface. Features include multi-domain support, Webhook notifications, custom parameters, Docker deployment, and system service integration.

repos.description: An all-in-one email service platform powered by Cloudflare  | 基于 Cloudflare 的一站式邮箱服务平台  | Cloudflare Email 邮箱 Mail
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的轻量级邮箱服务，集成 Resend 邮件发送、R2 附件存储与 D1 数据库，支持多用户管理、权限控制及数据可视化。采用 Vue3 + Element Plus 实现响应式界面，通过 Turnstile 人机验证保障安全，提供 API 接口与邮件推送功能，显著降低自建邮箱成本。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight email service built on Cloudflare Workers, integrating Resend for email delivery, R2 for file storage, and D1 for database operations. Features multi-user management, RBAC permissions, responsive UI with Vue3/Element Plus, Turnstile anti-bot protection, API endpoints, and data visualization via ECharts, offering a cost-effective self-hosted email solution.

repos.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: 这个项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具。它能够中转对 Docker 官方镜像仓库的请求，解决一些访问限制和加速访问的问题。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具，通过中转请求解决官方仓库访问限制与加速问题。支持 Docker、Containerd、Podman 等多种容器运行时配置镜像加速，提供一键部署方案，适用于跨境网络环境下的镜像拉取优化。
repos.summary_en: A Docker image proxy tool built on Cloudflare Workers that relays requests to official repositories to bypass access restrictions and accelerate downloads. Supports configuration for Docker, Containerd, and Podman runtimes with one-click deployment options, ideal for optimizing image pulls in cross-border networks.

repos.description: 🏖️ A serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. Supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: CloudFlare-ImgBed 是一个基于 Cloudflare 的无服务器开源文件托管解决方案，支持 Docker 和 Serverless 部署。它提供图片托管、安全文件存储和个人云盘功能，兼容 Telegram、Discord、R2、S3、Huggingface、WebDAV 等多种存储后端，并内置 RESTful API 与 WebDAV 支持，适用于轻量级私有云搭建。
repos.summary_en: CloudFlare-ImgBed is a serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. It supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities via Docker or serverless deployment. Compatible with multiple storage backends like R2, S3, WebDAV, and more, it offers RESTful APIs and WebDAV support for flexible integration.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: One Worker, All Subscriptions
repos.summary_zh: Sublink Worker 是一个轻量级订阅转换与管理工具，支持 ShadowSocks、VLESS、Hysteria2 等主流代理协议，兼容 Sing-Box、Clash 等客户端。通过 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 或 Docker 一键部署，提供 KV 存储的短链生成、多语言界面及自动化 API，适用于个人或团队统一管理多源代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: Sublink Worker is a lightweight subscription converter and manager supporting proxy protocols like ShadowSocks, VLESS, and Hysteria2. Deployable on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker, it offers short-link generation via KV storage, multi-language UI, and automation APIs for unified management of proxy subscriptions across clients such as Sing-Box and Clash.

repos.description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
repos.summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
repos.summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: A lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: 🌸Publish faster with an edge-native blog powered by Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2
repos.summary_zh: Rin是一个基于Cloudflare全栈无服务器架构的现代博客平台，集成Pages、Workers、D1和R2服务。支持GitHub OAuth登录、富文本编辑、实时自动保存、私有文章控制、图片拖拽上传、自定义URL别名、友链检测、评论系统及Webhook通知等功能，实现零运维部署的个人博客解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Rin is a modern serverless blog platform built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform, integrating Pages, Workers, D1, and R2. It features GitHub OAuth authentication, rich text editing, real-time autosave, privacy controls, image management, custom slugs, unlisted posts, blogroll with link validation, comment system, and webhook notifications for a fully managed blogging experience.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: Check酱：监测网页内容变化，并发送异动到微信。亦支持http status、json和rss监测。配合自架云端，关电脑后也能运行。
repos.summary_zh: Check酱是一款网页内容监控工具，支持通过浏览器插件监测网页内容变化，并将异动推送至微信等消息通道。支持HTTP状态、JSON和RSS监测，配合自建云端服务可实现24小时运行。具备可视化选择器、周期任务调度及多平台部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Check酱 is a web content monitoring tool that detects changes on web pages via a browser plugin and sends alerts to WeChat or other channels. It supports HTTP status, JSON, and RSS monitoring, with optional cloud deployment for continuous operation. Features include visual selector, scheduled tasks, and multi-platform support.

repos.description: 一站式域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、文件存储和子域名管理，带有管理员面板，支持自部署
repos.summary_zh: WR.DO 是一个功能强大的自托管域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、子域名管理、多平台文件存储和开放API接口。支持自定义短链、密码保护、访问统计、邮件推送等功能，提供完整的管理员面板，适合个人或企业自建域名服务基础设施。
repos.summary_en: WR.DO is a comprehensive self-hosted domain platform integrating short link generation, unlimited domain email, subdomain management, multi-cloud file storage, and open APIs. It supports custom links, password protection, analytics, email notifications, and provides a full admin panel for building private domain infrastructure.

repos.description: 开箱即有 800+ 可稳定流畅播放频道的自托管 IPTV 直播源管理与分发系统，聚合了央视频、咪咕、央视、卫视、凤凰卫视、亚太、国际、地方台、体育赛事、抖音直播、B 站直播、斗鱼直播、虎牙直播、会场、场馆等，以及自定义抓取源和订阅，并提供 EPG 节目单与聚合功能；另外还自带 GUI 可视化管理后台，支持 Docker Compose 或 Node.js 运行，适合 NAS 与家庭服务器。
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: AI资讯日报 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 驱动的内容聚合与生成平台。它每日为您精选 AI 领域的最新动态，包括行业新闻、热门开源项目、前沿学术论文、科技大V社交媒体言论，并通过 Google Gemini 模型进行智能处理与摘要生成，最终自动发布到 GitHub Pages 生成 AI 日报。
repos.summary_zh: AI资讯日报是基于Cloudflare Workers构建的自动化内容聚合平台，每日精选AI领域新闻、开源项目与学术论文，通过Google Gemini生成智能摘要并发布至GitHub Pages。支持Folo订阅源接入，提供网页、RSS及微信公众号多端阅读体验，兼具技术学习价值与个人定制潜力。
repos.summary_en: AI Insight Daily is an automated content aggregation platform built on Cloudflare Workers. It curates daily AI news, open-source projects, and research papers, generating intelligent summaries via Google Gemini and publishing them to GitHub Pages. Supports Folo RSS feeds, offering multi-platform access via web, RSS, and WeChat Official Account, serving as both a learning resource and customizable tool.

repos.description: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: NaviHive 是一个精美的个人网站导航管理系统，帮助你整理和管理你收藏的网站链接。支持分组管理、拖拽排序、暗色模式等功能，让你的网站收藏更有条理、更易访问。
repos.summary_zh: NaviHive 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的现代化个人网站导航管理系统，支持分组管理、拖拽排序和暗色模式。采用 React + TypeScript + Material UI 技术栈，零成本部署于全球 CDN，提供企业级安全与快速访问体验。
repos.summary_en: NaviHive is a modern personal website navigation management system built on Cloudflare Workers. It supports grouping, drag-and-drop sorting, and dark mode. Powered by React, TypeScript, and Material UI, it offers zero-cost deployment with global CDN acceleration and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 的免费网页归档与分享服务，提供浏览器插件、云端存储和检索功能。支持单文件 HTML 保存、文件夹分类、AI 标签生成及移动端适配，实现网页内容的永久存档与便捷共享。
repos.summary_en: A free web archiving and sharing service built on Cloudflare Workers, featuring a browser plugin for saving webpages as single HTML files, cloud-based storage with D1 database and R2 bucket, AI-generated tags, folder organization, and mobile-optimized reading mode.

repos.description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
repos.summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
repos.summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理服务，支持 Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV 一键部署，提供流/非流式对话、图像生成、深度思考等功能。具备号池并发、自动负载均衡、Token/API Key 管理、后台面板等核心能力，三端部署行为一致，适配移动端并增强筛选与状态判定逻辑。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based proxy for Grok AI, supporting one-click deployment on Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV with streaming/non-streaming chat, image generation, deep thinking, concurrent token pools, and auto load balancing. It features unified management panels, mobile adaptation, enhanced token filtering, and consistent behavior across local/FastAPI/Docker/Workers deployments.

repos.description: ✨一个部署在CF的轻量化导航页面，可移动卡片式书签，方便管理
repos.summary_zh: Card-Tab 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的轻量化书签管理页面，采用卡片式布局支持拖拽排序、分类管理和暗色主题切换。具备多搜索引擎集成、JWT登录验证、KV存储备份及实时天气显示等功能，适合个人快速搭建个性化导航站。
repos.summary_en: Card-Tab is a lightweight bookmark management page deployed on Cloudflare Workers, featuring card-based layout with drag-and-drop sorting, custom categories, dark mode, and multi-engine search. It supports JWT authentication, KV storage backups, and real-time weather display for personalized navigation.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

repos.description: 这是一个用于监控和检测 Ollama 服务可用性和性能的系统。它提供了一个现代化的 Web 界面，支持多语言（中文/英文），并具有实时检测和数据展示功能。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个专为 Ollama 服务设计的现代化监控系统，提供实时可用性检测、性能监控（响应时间/TPS）和模型状态展示。支持多语言界面、批量服务检测、FOFA 扫描及数据导出功能，采用 Next.js 14 + TypeScript 构建，具备响应式设计和国际化能力。
repos.summary_en: A modern monitoring system for Ollama services that provides real-time availability detection, performance metrics (response time/TPS), and model status tracking. Features multi-language support, batch service scanning, FOFA integration, data export, and a responsive web interface built with Next.js 14 and TypeScript.

repos.description: AI 每日新闻简报 · GitHub 热门 + X 热门文章 + 行情技术分析 · 23 个数据源聚合 + LLM 中文摘要 · 本地或 GitHub Actions 部署
repos.summary_zh: DailyBrief 是一款 AI 驱动的每日新闻简报工具，聚合 GitHub、X（推特）、财经及国际媒体等 23 个数据源，支持 21 个股票/加密标的的技术指标与 LLM 中文摘要。核心亮点包括：5 种可插拔 LLM 后端（Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax）、中英双语支持、零基础设施的 GitHub Actions 一键部署，以及单文件 HTML 无依赖输出。适用于个人投资者、技术极客及资讯聚合场景，实现自动化、个性化的每日简报生成。
repos.summary_en: DailyBrief is an AI-powered daily news briefing tool that aggregates content from 23 sources including GitHub, X (Twitter), financial and international media. It features real-time technical indicators for 21 stocks/crypto assets with LLM-generated Chinese summaries. Key highlights: 5 plug-and-play LLM backends (Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax), bilingual support, zero-infrastructure deployment via GitHub Actions, and standalone HTML output. Ideal for investors, tech enthusiasts, and automated information aggregation.

repos.description: 基于deno的抖音视频图文无水印下载，支持cf worker,vercel,deno deploy,docker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Deno 的抖音无水印视频与图文下载服务，支持多平台部署（Deno Deploy、Cloudflare Workers、Vercel、Docker），通过简单 API 调用即可解析并返回原始媒体链接，适用于内容抓取与自动化处理场景。
repos.summary_en: A Deno-based service for downloading watermark-free Douyin videos and images via URL parsing, supporting deployment on Deno Deploy, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Docker. Provides clean media links through a simple GET API for content extraction and automation.

repos.description: GithubAction的使用样例，天气推送，薅羊毛，打卡签到
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 GitHub Actions 实战样例，演示如何通过无服务器 Python 程序实现自动化任务。核心功能包括跨平台画爱心程序构建、微信公众号天气推送及京东签到薅羊毛。通过 Secrets 管理敏感信息，支持定时任务调度，适合学习 CI/CD 与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides practical examples of GitHub Actions for serverless automation. Key features include cross-platform executable generation (e.g., drawing hearts), weather push notifications via WeChat Official Account, and JD.com daily check-in 'money-saving' bots. It uses GitHub Secrets for secure credential management and cron-based scheduling.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: 个人基于chenyme Grok2API的修改版本，在原版基础上支持nsfw全程工作流，视频工作台循环拼接，夜间模式和移动端UI适配等
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 的个人化 Grok API 部署项目，支持 NSFW 工作流、视频拼接、夜间模式及移动端适配。提供 Docker/Render/Vercel 多平台一键部署，兼容本地与云端存储，适用于个人开发、API 集成及私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a personal deployment of Grok API based on FastAPI, supporting NSFW workflows, video stitching, dark mode, and mobile UI. It offers one-click deployment via Docker/Render/Vercel with support for local or remote storage, ideal for private development, API integration, and self-hosted use.

repos.description: BetterClaude API Gateway
repos.summary_zh: BetterClaude Gateway 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的智能 Claude API 代理，专为解决工具调用中 orphaned tool_result 错误而设计。它能主动检测并清除消息历史中无效的 tool_result 块，支持透明转发、智能重试和边缘计算，显著提升 Claude API 在复杂对话场景下的稳定性与可用性。
repos.summary_en: BetterClaude Gateway is an intelligent Claude API proxy built on Cloudflare Workers, specifically designed to fix orphaned tool_result errors. It proactively detects and removes invalid tool_result blocks from message history, supports transparent forwarding, smart retry with reactive fallback, and leverages edge computing for global low-latency access, greatly improving reliability in complex tool-use scenarios.

repos.description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
repos.summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
repos.summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: Mynah — self-hosted realtime digital human. One GPU, full admin console, Apache-2.0. 自己服务器上的实时数字人系统
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: serv00和ct8主机一键安装哪吒探针和多主机保活
repos.summary_zh: 专为serv00和ct8低配主机设计的一键安装脚本，支持哪吒探针v0/v1版本自动部署、多主机SSH密钥保活及进程监控。通过crontab实现探针进程自愈与跨主机联动保活，集成企业微信/Telegram通知、云存储数据库备份等功能，显著提升探针面板稳定性。
repos.summary_en: A specialized one-click installer for serv00 and ct8 low-end hosts, enabling automatic deployment of Nezha Probe v0/v1 dashboards/agents with multi-host SSH key-based survival. Features crontab-driven process monitoring, cross-host recovery, enterprise WeChat/Telegram alerts, and cloud database backups to enhance probe stability.

repos.description: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
repos.summary_zh: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
repos.summary_en: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

repos.description: 🚀轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具
repos.summary_zh: NekoFlare 是一款基于 UCB 算法的轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具，通过多臂老虎机模型动态评估边缘节点性能。结合 TCP 延迟与 HTTP 吞吐量加权评分，实现探索与利用的平衡，自动收敛至最优网段。支持 IPv4/IPv6 扫描，无需第三方依赖，适用于本地 hosts 优化。
repos.summary_en: NekoFlare is a lightweight tool for optimizing Cloudflare edge node selection using the Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm. It employs a multi-armed bandit model to balance exploration and exploitation, dynamically scoring IPs based on TCP latency and HTTP throughput. Automatically converges to optimal subnets while supporting IPv4/IPv6 scanning with zero external dependencies.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 通过可视化向导，根据你的开发技术栈，选择配置好Skills，MCP，Agent的AI开发工具，一键生成容器化Vibe开发环境。
repos.summary_zh: VibeSpace 是一款可视化 AI 开发环境配置工具，通过向导式界面快速生成生产可用的容器化开发环境。支持多语言（Go/Node.js/Python/Rust/Java/C++）、AI 工具（Claude Code/Roo）集成、MCP Server 配置及工作流预设，内置国内镜像源优化，一键输出 Dockerfile、docker-compose.yml 等部署文件，实现安全隔离的 Vibe Coding 开发体验。
repos.summary_en: VibeSpace is a visual configuration tool that generates production-ready containerized AI development environments. It supports multi-language setups (Go, Node.js, Python, Rust, Java, C/C++), integrates AI tools like Claude Code and Roo with MCP servers and workflows, auto-configures domestic mirrors for China users, and outputs deployable Docker artifacts via a guided UI—enabling secure, no-enter Vibe Coding.

repos.description: 利用bpb漏洞获取免费的节点，cloudflareWorkers部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于BPB面板漏洞的免费节点生成工具，通过Cloudflare Workers实现自动化部署，支持一键获取免费节点，降低使用门槛，适合小白用户快速上手。
repos.summary_en: A free node generator exploiting BPB panel vulnerabilities, deployed via Cloudflare Workers for one-click access to nodes, enabling easy setup and continuous availability for users.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Grok AI 代理服务，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 和可视化 Web 管理界面，支持文本对话、多规格图片生成及视频创作，具备 Token 自动轮换、API Key 速率限制与一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A Cloudflare Workers-based proxy for Grok AI, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs and a web admin interface. Supports text chat, image/video generation with customizable ratios, token auto-rotation, rate limiting, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: 工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.

repos.description: 即梦海外版 | Dreamina (CapCut AI) 图像生成 API | 基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署
repos.summary_zh: 即梦海外版 Dreamina API 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建，采用异步任务模式解决30秒超时限制。支持文生图、图生图及多模型（4.5/4.1/4.0），提供 OpenAI 兼容接口与可视化 Web 界面，全球边缘节点部署，无需服务器即可实现 AI 图像生成服务。
repos.summary_en: Dreamina API (CapCut AI) built on Cloudflare Workers uses asynchronous task mode to bypass 30s timeout limits. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and multiple models (4.5/4.1/4.0), offers OpenAI-compatible endpoints with a visual web interface, and deploys globally via edge nodes without server infrastructure.

repos.description: MCP Server Unified Deployment Open Source Project
repos.summary_zh: MCP服务器统一部署工具是一个开源项目，旨在将不同形式的MCP服务器（如uvx、npx等）转换为标准化的SSE协议部署，实现多服务器统一管理。支持跨平台运行，提供灵活的配置选项和完整的Docker部署方案，适用于生产环境和大规模管理场景。
repos.summary_en: MCP Server Unified Deployment is an open-source tool that standardizes various MCP server implementations (e.g., uvx, npx) into a unified SSE protocol deployment. It enables centralized management of multiple MCP servers across platforms with flexible configuration and comprehensive Docker support for production environments.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目演示如何使用 Docker Compose 快速搭建基于 Docker 的 Django 应用开发环境，包含 Django、MySQL 和 Redis 服务编排，支持一键构建与部署，适用于容器化 Django 项目的开发与测试。
repos.summary_en: This project demonstrates how to quickly set up a Django development environment using Docker Compose, including orchestration of Django, MySQL, and Redis services. It supports one-click build and deployment, ideal for containerized Django development and testing.

repos.description: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的临时邮箱控制台。接收邮件后，根据可配置的正则规则自动提取关键数据（如验证码），并通过 API 对外提供查询能力。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的无服务器临时邮箱系统，支持自动接收邮件、正则规则提取验证码等关键信息，并提供 RESTful API 查询接口。具备白名单过滤、邮件转发、定时清理及可视化控制台管理功能，适用于自动化验证与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless temporary email console built with Cloudflare Workers and D1, automatically receives emails, extracts key data (e.g., verification codes) via configurable regex rules, and exposes a RESTful API for querying. Features include sender whitelisting, email forwarding, cron-based cleanup, and a web admin console for management.

repos.description: 一个类似于o1的思维过程
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个模拟 GPT-4o1 思维过程的 AI 推理系统，基于 bklieger-groq 的 g1 项目改进而来。支持多步推理、可解释性输出，提供 Streamlit 和 Cloudflare Worker 两种部署方式，兼容多种 LLM（如 Llama-3.1 70b）及 API 服务商，适用于复杂问题分析与决策支持场景。
repos.summary_en: This project simulates the reasoning process of GPT-4o1, extending the original g1-prototype from bklieger-groq. It enables multi-step, interpretable inference using various large language models (e.g., Llama-3.1 70b) via configurable APIs. Available as both a Streamlit web app and a deployable Cloudflare Worker, it supports real-time step-by-step output for complex problem-solving.
